verdict.rationale: Domain authentication is a fair axis for an email marketing platform, but the evidence pack never mentions SPF, DKIM, DMARC, sending-domain connection, or guided DNS setup and verification. The only related item covers setting the sender name and address, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can authenticate my own sending domain — SPF, DKIM, DMARC alignment — with guided DNS setup and verification
